description.text: I. Professional Overview Trade economy focuses on "commercial circulation" as its core research object. It mainly explores the entire process of commodity circulation from production to consumption, including market operation mechanisms, trade rules, circulation channel management, and operation of commercial enterprises. It not only pays attention to the organization and regulation of domestic trade but also covers the cross-disciplinary field of integrated domestic and foreign trade, aiming to solve problems such as resource allocation, efficiency improvement, and business model innovation in commercial circulation. It is an important discipline that connects production and consumption. With the development of the digital economy, this major has gradually integrated into emerging fields such as e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce, and new retail, emphasizing the combination of traditional trade and modern information technology.II. Training Objectives This major aims to cultivate applied and multi-skilled talents with a solid foundation in economics and management theories, proficient in the basic principles and operational skills of modern commercial circulation, familiar with domestic trade policies and regulations, market operation rules, and international trade-related knowledge. These talents should be able to work in various commercial enterprises, government commercial management departments, financial institutions, etc., in positions such as market analysis, trade operation, channel management, and policy research. Specific requirements include strong market insight, business practice operation skills, data analysis capabilities, as well as excellent communication, coordination and innovative thinking skills.

duration.text: The Trade Economics at Xi'an University of Finance And Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

Valid personal passport; 3. Study Plan, no less than 300 words; 4. Highest educational qualification certificate (Fresh graduates should provide a certificate indicating expected graduation); 5. Academic transcript 6. Certificate of No Criminal Record of the Country, valid for 6 months; 7. Recommendation letter from the school where you are currently studying; 8. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" 9. Proof of Chinese Language Learning (if any); 10. Other materials that can demonstrate one's comprehensive qualities (if any).

requirements.text: 1. Have the nationality of the countries along the "the Belt and Road", hold a valid foreign ordinary passport, be friendly to China, and be healthy.2. Have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, and have no record of illegal or criminal activities.3. Applicants must have a degree equivalent to that of a Chinese high school graduate and be under the age of 25 (students under the age of 18 must provide a power of attorney and other materials from their legal guardian).
